incident-bot: 🚨 Service alert: elevated 5xx and latency observed on inference-service (prod us-west-2). Paging @Priya (oncall) and @Ethan (sre).

Priya (oncall): seeing p50/p95 jump and steady stream of 502s since ~22:03 UTC. current error-rate ~20% over the last 15m. dashboards and tracing look noisy.

Ethan (sre): ack. pulling deploy history for last 2 hours. any config pushes?

Devon (product): we rolled a KV-cache tuning config at 22:07 to lower memory usage. small change but could have behavioral impacts.

Priya (oncall): is the change behind a flag? can we flip it to test?

oncall-shadow: yes, flag is `kvcache_v2_enabled`. endpoint for toggle: `POST https://ops.internal/flags/kvcache_v2_enabled/false`. will execute if SRE gives thumbs.

Ethan (sre): go ahead and toggle. simultaneously Im provisioning extra inference pods in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 to redistribute load.

Ethan (sre): toggle API returned 200. metrics show error-rate dropping from 20% -> ~3% within 6 minutes. p95 latency trending down.

Priya (oncall): mitigation looks effective. marking incident state as MITIGATED. we'll keep monitoring for 30m then update status page as resolved/monitoring.

Marta (support): collecting impacted tenant list now. filter: requests with 5xx between 22:00 and 23:55 UTC. initial pass: 12 tenants with occasional errors, 5 tenants with >10 minutes blurred errors, 2 tenants with ~1h continuous elevated errors. attaching counts in thread artifact.

Jin (billing-ops): thanks. remind me of eligible SLA thresholds. Standard = 99.9% (~43.2 allowed downtime/month), Enterprise = 99.95% (~21.6). once I have precise minutes per tenant I will compute credits.

Devon (product): drafting status-page blurb. suggestion: short, non-technical, transparent.

Priya (oncall): draft status update: ```We experienced an elevated error rate affecting generation and chat endpoints in us-west-2 starting ~2026-03-14 22:00 UTC. Mitigation (feature-flag revert + increased capacity) has restored normal operation. We are investigating root cause and will publish an RCA and any applicable credit decisions within 48 hours.```

Marta (support): customer DM draft for those directly impacted: ```Hi — we detected intermittent failures on the Redwood inference API between 22:00 and 23:55 UTC on 2026-03-14 which may have affected requests to your service. We have mitigated the issue and systems are stable. We are reviewing logs to confirm exact counts and will follow up within 48 hours with impact details and next steps, including any applicable service credits. Apologies for the disruption. — Marta, Redwood Support```

Ethan (sre): I'll start the RCA doc. immediate root cause hypothesis: config change to cache invalidation timings causing increased cache misses under bursty traffic; leads to downstream overload and 5xx. will confirm with traces and kernel-level metrics. target: RCA draft in 48 hours.

Priya (oncall): internal incident summary to add to ops runbook: ```INCIDENT: inference-service high error-rate (prod us-west-2). Start: 2026-03-14 22:00 UTC. Mitigated: 2026-03-14 23:55 UTC. Trigger: KV-cache tuning config (kvcache_v2) introduced invalidation edge-case under burst. Mitigation: toggled flag, scaled up inference capacity, monitored. Impact: intermittent 5xx and elevated latency; small subset of customers had prolonged errors. Next steps: revert change permanently or redesign; add pre-deploy canary; raise automated alert when error-rate >5% for 3m; billing to compute credits.```

Jin (billing-ops): once Marta posts the tenant windows, I'll generate a credit spreadsheet. my calc template: credit_pct = max(0, (downtime_minutes - SLA_allowed_minutes) / total_month_minutes) * 100. then map pct to invoice amount. will propose both % credit and approximate $ amount.

Marta (support): DMs sent to the 5 most-impacted tenants now. two replies already requesting logs and a timeline for audit. prioritizing those.

Devon (product): small note for public comms: explicitly state no customer data was exposed, only availability impacted. keeps compliance teams happy.

Ethan (sre): exported logs and flamegraphs to S3: s3://incidents/2156600123/artifacts.tar.gz. added basic timeline charts. attaching to thread.

Priya (oncall): action items recap: 1) publish status page update as MITIGATED -> RESOLVED once stabilized; 2) SRE to deliver RCA draft in 48h; 3) Support to follow up with customers and provide logs on request; 4) Billing to compute credits and share template for customer comms; 5) Product to own retro and canary requirements.

Jin (billing-ops): i'll post preliminary credit numbers in ~4 business hours after parsing tenant windows. will include messaging template for Finance.

Marta (support): created tickets for the two customers that asked for immediate logs and for internal audit requests.

Devon (product): asking execs for sign-off to proactively offer a one-time invoice adjustment to enterprise customers who had >30 minutes impact. will ping here when decision made.

Priya (oncall): closing incident page as RESOLVED / monitoring. if anything regresses reopen. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status changed to RESOLVED (monitoring). initial status posted. follow-ups: RCA and credits calculation in progress.
